sentence: This project studies how lysosomes and gut granules change shape in response to zinc, using C. elegans and human cells.
This project builds a plan to help college-based young adults sit less, aiming to prevent cardiometabolic diseases.
This project studies how B cells are controlled in lupus and other autoimmune diseases.
This project builds a platform that finds natural products in complex microbial and plant datasets.
This project supports work on cancer heterogeneity, immunity and the microenvironment to help move toward more durable and selective cancer therapies.
This project tests whether starch, by changing the microbiome, can lower the risk of graft versus host disease.
This project studies how host-pathogen interactions drive persistent bloodstream infections, using computational methods to find hidden patterns in large datasets.
This project provides bioinformatics services that help researchers use electronic medical record data, including natural language processing to read narrative notes.
This project brings researchers together to discuss how chromatin, transcription and epigenetics relate to aging and age-related diseases.
This project studies the biology of immune problems that follow chimeric antigen receptor T-cell treatment of leukemia and tests possible therapies.
This project studies how a kinase linked to intellectual disability and neurodegenerative diseases controls the microtubule cytoskeleton by acting on microtubule-associated proteins.
This project builds a microchip that isolates and profiles circulating tumor cell subtypes in blood during epithelial and mesenchymal transition.
This project builds a way to record from the entire brain at once, called mesoscopic electrophysiology.
This project studies how thermoneutral housing protects against fibrotic lung disease, using human and animal studies.
This project studies how phosphodiesterase 4 enzymes and certain receptor subunits affect alcohol tolerance and alcohol consumption.
This project studies the clinical and biological meaning of a hypermethylated subtype of metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer.
This project tests a bispecific T cell engager, an antibody drug, as a treatment for allergic diseases.
This project uses a mouse model to study how prenatal alcohol exposure changes frontoparietal signaling during cognitive control.
This project tests imaging tools from non-contrast head CT and deep learning models to guide treatment decisions in acute ischemic stroke.
This project combines imaging and genomic data from bipolar disorder centers around the world to study bipolar disorder.
